text: Amway Vietnam named among Southeast Asia's top 100 employers for second year

HCM City - Amway Vietnam has once again been named in Fortune magazine's '100 Best Companies to Work For in Southeast Asia 2026' list, compiled in partnership with Great Place To Work, marking the second consecutive year the company has received this recognition.
The ranking evaluates corporate culture and employee experience through Great Place To Work's Trust Index survey.
In 2026, the survey covered more than 1.3 million employees across the region, identifying 100 companies with outstanding workplace environments and corporate cultures.
To qualify, companies must hold Great Place To Work certification in at least one of the 10 Southeast Asian countries and employ at least 200 people.

According to the survey results at Amway Vietnam, 94 per cent of employees rated the company as an 'Excellent Place to Work', while 24 out of 25 core criteria received approval ratings of over 90 per cent.
These results reflect employees' satisfaction and trust in a workplace that values respect, openness and recognition of individual contributions.

Amway Vietnam said it places strong emphasis on developing a people-centred corporate culture, providing employees with opportunities to enhance their professional skills, develop leadership capabilities and maintain work-life balance.
This approach is aligned with the company's mission to 'help people live better lives'.

In terms of business performance, Amway Vietnam has recorded 10 consecutive years of growth and ranks among the top nine markets by revenue out of more than 100 markets worldwide within the Amway Corporation.
Notably, more than one-third of its employees have worked for the company for over 10 years, reflecting workforce stability and long-term commitment.
Lê Thị Kim Hoa, Human Resources Director at Amway Vietnam, said the company's inclusion in the Fortune ranking for two consecutive years was recognition of its long-term human resources strategy.
She added that the achievement would motivate the company to continue improving its employee policies and programmes.
Amway Vietnam's continued presence on the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For in Southeast Asia list reaffirms its commitment to building a people-centred workplace.
